_doc: Revert-verify mutants for ticket 21123711 / req 28cd60a7 (the refusal of `exosync quarantine resolve` names the argument that did not match). Run from the repo root: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py packages/cli/tests/unit/commands/quarantine-resolve-refusal-21123711.spec.json after setting `tree` and `subject` to YOUR checkout (both absolute; committed with a placeholder so a run cannot mutate a neighbouring session's worktree — integration-test-revert-verify §A76). Guards enumerated from `git diff -U0` (§A8). ⛤ The axes live in the EXISTING production-shape suite (exosync-quarantine.test.ts) rather than a new file: its fixture builds a real temp vault with an AssetSpace declaration, a hand-seeded device-local watermark with a pinned conflict and the FakeGitHubRepo transport, and duplicating that would be a worse fixture, not a cleaner one (test-fixture-realism). No sibling `<base>-verify` harness exists ON PURPOSE — the subject is TypeScript driven by jest, which the driver runs through `harness` (hook-matcher-vs-declared-surface §A19). ⛔ ONE guard of the diff carries no mutant, and the honest reason (§A118) is that the fixture cannot produce its input: the `matches.length > 1` branch needs the SAME repo-relative path open in TWO assetspaces, and `makeConflictVault` seeds exactly one declaration. That branch is untouched by this diff (0 lines) and is the SOURCE of the enumeration form used here, not a claim being made about it.

MQ1_old_single_sentence_restored._note: ORCH-required: the replaced assertion must be an AXIS on the new behaviour, not merely a test that stopped failing. Restoring the retracted one-sentence refusal must redden it. ⛤ The first draft of this mutant reproduced the retracted sentence with its nested backticks around `exosync quarantine list`, which the JSON escaping turned into invalid TypeScript — the driver reported BROKEN, and BROKEN is the ABSENCE of a measurement, not a measurement (§A97). The backticks are dropped; what the mutant restores is the single-sentence SHAPE, which is what the axes judge. ⛤ Predicted [Q2, Q3] and MEASURED [Q1, Q2, Q3]: the mutant also replaces the no-conflicts branch, so Q1's assertion on the new wording fails too — a legitimate third consequence, recorded as measured (§A44), not fitted the other way round.

MQ2_state_claim_for_every_input._note: The conjunctive selector collapsed back into one outcome: every input gets the no-conflicts sentence.

MQ3_path_and_repo_outcomes_swapped._note: The two argument-specific outcomes must not be interchangeable: each names a DIFFERENT argument.

MQ4_open_paths_not_enumerated._note: Naming the argument without the executable values leaves the caller guessing — the defect #4206 already fixed for `list`.

MQ6_refusal_exit_code_dropped._note: A guard has TWO deliveries (§A31): the exit code and the diagnostic. This mutant covers the first — losing it while editing the text is the quiet way to weaken the command.

MQ7_device_local_note_dropped._note: Half two of the ticket: the backup is named device-local and deletable. The backup itself is untouched — req e85487a7 pins it.
